The '''MC-24a light shuttle''' was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]]-produced short-range [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]].

==Characteristics==
The shuttle possessed a smooth, curved design, typical for [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] starships. Shuttles of this kind were armed and were equipped with miniaturized back-up [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generators]].<ref name="LECG" />

==History==
[[File:LECGMc24a.jpg|left|thumb|250ppx|A MC-24a light shuttle above the Mon Calamari Shipyards.]]
The MC-24a shuttles were primarily meant to be used by personnel at the [[Mon Calamari Shipyards/Legends|Mon Calamari Shipyards]] to travel between areas among the construction bays. Other worlds plagued with harsh atmospheric conditions or low-orbit debris bought MC-24a shuttles based on their good handling in those conditions.<ref name="LECG" />

During the crackdown on Calamari resistance after the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Second Imperial Civil War)|Battle of Mon Calamari]] in [[137 ABY]], MC-24a's were used to ferry resistance members between safe houses.<ref name="LECG" />
